verdict: Yes, for a team with IoT and veterinary knowledge. We STOCK from Ernakulam pitched IoT tags that monitor livestock health on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Dairy farmers lose money when illness or heat cycles go unnoticed, and tags that flag them early save real money.
angle: India has the world's largest cattle population, but most farms still track animals by eye. Sensor tags that detect illness, heat and feeding changes help farmers and dairy co-operatives. Insurers and dairies can also pay for the data.
